title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: CX AI & Knowledge Manager (Remote/Brazil)
description:
About us

Carepod is a growing e-commerce brand focused on delivering a great customer experience at every step. We believe support should be fast, accurate, human, and scalable. We use AI to help our team work smarter, but we still care deeply about quality, clarity, and trust.


About the role

We are hiring a CX AI & Knowledge Manager to own the systems behind great support.

This person will manage our customer-facing knowledge, train and improve Gorgias AI , review and QA AI responses, keep our FAQ and help center up to date, and help train our team on the right processes and information.

You will be the person making sure our customers get accurate answers, our AI gets smarter over time, and our support team has the tools and guidance they need to do great work.


What you’ll own
  • Own and maintain the source of truth for support knowledge, product information, policies, and FAQs
  • Train, test, and improve Gorgias AI so responses are accurate, helpful, and on-brand
  • Review AI-generated customer responses and build a QA process to catch issues early
  • Update help center articles, FAQs, macros, and internal SOPs as products and policies change
  • Work with CX, product, operations, and marketing teams to keep information consistent across channels
  • Help onboard and train support team members on tools, workflows, and knowledge resources
  • Identify repeated support issues and fix the root cause through better documentation, automation, or training
  • Track key metrics tied to AI quality, knowledge coverage, support accuracy, and team enablement


What success looks like in the first 90 days
  • Audit our current help center, macros, and Gorgias AI setup
  • Clean up the biggest knowledge gaps affecting customers and support agents
  • Improve AI response quality for our most common support questions
  • Launch a simple QA process for AI responses

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

-Analisar, diagnosticar e apresentar soluções técnico-administrativas relativas aos Programas de Aprendizagem Profissional do Senac, por meio de dados, indicadores, relatórios, conformidade, efetividade pedagógica, propondo recomendações técnico-administrativas para aprimoramento do programa em escala nacional.

-Elaborar documentos técnicos e analíticos relativos às demandas da Aprendizagem Profissional, abrangendo avaliações de impacto, comparativos entre regionais e recomendações estratégicas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão.

-Executar outras atividades, correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalentes graus de responsabilidade e complexidade.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

Conceitos e fundamentos da educação profissional e tecnológica; normativas que regulamentam a Aprendizagem Profissional (Lei nº 10.097/2000; Decreto 9.579/2018; Portaria MTE 3.872/2023; dentre outras); informações técnico/operacionais da Aprendizagem Profissional; Catálogo Nacional da Aprendizagem (CONAP) e Cadastro Nacional da Aprendizagem Profissional (CNAP); redação de textos técnicos educacionais; Pacote Office em nível intermediário; ferramentas de apresentação (Canva, PowerPoint, Prezi entre outros).

title: Senior Voip Engineer
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior VoIP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.

This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.

This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
  • Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
  • Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
  • Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
  • Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.

What we're looking for:


Required

  • 5+ years as a developer building VoIP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
  • Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:

A B2BUA / media server: Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or OpenSIPS

  • Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
  • Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
  • Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Strong plus

  • Python for automation, tooling, or service development.
  • SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS).
  • DevOps and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, WebRTC gateways, or SBCs.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.


Why this role

  • Fully remote with a flexible working model.
  • Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
  • High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
  • Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
  • Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

  • Notion ou Confluence para organização de conteúdo e documentação;

Habilidades Preferenciais


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Didática e clareza na transmissão de conteúdos.
  • Organização e gestão de tempo.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar indicadores.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono.
  • Boa relação interpessoal (interface constante com BPO e áreas internas).


Modelo de Trabalho


Híbrido, com possibilidade de facilitação presencial e remota. Disponibilidade para interações com o BPO.


Indicadores de Sucesso (KPIs)


  • Aderência ao cronograma (trainings delivered vs planned).

  • Nota média de avaliação de aprendizagem.
  • Aderência e padronização dos instrutores do BPO.
  • Redução de erros operacionais pós-treinamento.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

ITTConnect is seeking a VMWare Cloud Engineer expert in Cloud Formation to work remotely for a client in the US.


The VCF expert will design, deploy, and support modern VMware infrastructure. This role focuses on building stable, scalable environments using vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and SRM, while enabling hybrid‑cloud capabilities.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Deploy and manage VCF, including management and workload domains.
  • Implement and optimize vSphere, vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, and SRM.
  • Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, and network virtualization.
  • Perform capacity planning, health checks, and risk assessments.
  • Produce documentation and operational handoff materials.
  • Support DR architecture and testing.
  • Provide knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • MUST BE an expert in VMWare Cloud Foundation
  • Experience with VCF or large‑scale VMware deployments.
  • Strong understanding of virtualization, networking, and storage.
  • Hands‑on with at least two: vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, SRM.
  • Familiarity with HCI platforms (e.g. Dell VxRail).
  • Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred

  • VMware certifications (VCP/VCAP/VCIX).
  • Experience with automation (PowerCLI, Ansible, Terraform).
  • Exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid integrations.
  • Knowledge of backup/storage platforms like PowerStore or Veeam.
  • Previous experience in Consulting and/or client facing roles

  • Fluência em inglês falado e escrito (comunicação clara e natural);
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente, suporte comercial ou pré-vendas;
  • Habilidade em comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês, com empatia e assertividade;
  • Organização e autonomia para trabalhar de forma autogerenciada;
  • Curiosidade para aprender, testar abordagens e melhorar processos;
  • Familiaridade com CRM, WhatsApp Business, e-mail profissional e ferramentas digitais;
  • Conhecimento básico de funil de vendas e marketing digital é um diferencial.


DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em vendas 100% remotas


PERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL DESEJÁVEL:

  • Autogerenciável , com responsabilidade e organização pessoal;
  • Proativo(a) , com iniciativa para sugerir melhorias nos processos de atendimento;
  • Flexível , com disponibilidade para eventuais atendimentos fora do horário comercial;
  • Boa dicção, oratória e domínio do inglês para uma comunicação clara e acolhedora;
  • Curioso(a), com vontade de aprender e testar novas abordagens ;
  • Ágil, comunicativo(a) e engajado(a) com foco na experiência do cliente.

Somos uma agência de marketing focada em ajudar empresários brasileiros a expandirem seus negócios nos Estados Unidos. Atuamos como parceiro estratégico dos nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções completas em marketing digital, posicionamento e performance. Acreditamos que crescimento real acontece com estratégia e ação constante – e é isso que entregamos.

  • Gerar uma visão consolidada para a liderança executiva, trazendo insights, aprendizados e direcionamentos estratégicos.

  • Entendimento prático de como soluções de tecnologia/AI geram valor.
  • Capacidade de definir e acompanhar métricas de impacto e adoção.
  • Alta capacidade de influência e articulação com diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Pensamento estruturado e visão sistêmica.

  • Perfil analítico com forte orientação a resultado.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono.
  • Habilidade de navegar em ambientes ambíguos e em construção.

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

title: Sales Manager, Laparoscopy Systems
description:
About the Company


Reach Surgical, a Genesis Medtech Company, is a leading minimally-invasive surgical device manufacturer and supplier, committed to serving high-quality products to healthcare practitioners and patients worldwide. We deliver advanced technology and cost effective minimally-invasive surgical products to medical institutions and provide patients with reliable and economical treatment solutions.


About the Role


We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager to spearhead regional sales management, drive business growth, and accelerate the expansion of Laparoscopic products for Brazil.


Responsibilities


As the Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the sales management of Laparoscopic products within the assigned geographic area and markets to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. You will conduct market research including customers and competitors’ activities and formulate and execute market development strategies. In addition, you will develop and build long-lasting relationships with stakeholders including distributors and healthcare professionals and obtain feedback on our products to internal stakeholders.


1. Development and Execution of Sales Plans


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Define clear and measurable overseas sales goals, develop corresponding action plans, and execute them effectively to meet company objectives.
  • Market Intelligence: Conduct detailed hospital and micro-market analysis; maintain up-to-date market intelligence to understand industry trends and competitive landscapes.
  • Competitive Strategy: Formulate and implement effective competitive strategies based on insights into market dynamics and competitor activities.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support regional marketing activities, leverage internal and external resources efficiently, and enhance overall customer value.
  • Decision-Making: Maintain a deep understanding of regional market conditions; identify emerging opportunities and potential challenges to make informed and timely decisions.


2. KOL (Key Opinion Leader) Management


  • Database Development : Establish and maintain a comprehensive overseas KOL information archive.
  • Customer Insight : Analyze the potential and specific needs of KOLs to develop targeted engagement plans.
  • Relationship Management : Strategically allocate resources to build, strengthen, and sustain long-term cooperative relationships with KOLs.


3. Distributor Management


  • Distributor Development : Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors that meet company criteria and strategic alignment.
  • Performance Support & Training: Provide motivation, ongoing support, and training to ensure distributors adhere to company standards and deliver expected outcomes.
  • Channel Optimization : Demonstrate strong communication and distributor management skills; conduct regular performance reviews and offer actionable feedback to maintain an effective and healthy distribution network.


Qualifications & Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Management, Marketing, Trade, Life Sciences, Clinical Sciences or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in international sales or business development, preferably experience in the laparoscopic industry.
  • Proficiency in English is required
  • Strong sales and negotiation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in cross-cultural communication.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo.


Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end)
  • Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components
  • Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models
  • SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data


Plusses

  • Experience with C++ development
  • Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes


Day-to-Day

You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Latin America Sales Representative
description:
Latin America Sales Manager


Location: Argentina or Brazil (remote with frequent regional travel)

Languages: Fluent Spanish and Portuguese; English required


Role Overview


We are the #1 smart pool cleaning robot company globally, leading innovation in intelligent outdoor robotics. As we continue our rapid global expansion, Latin America is one of our key growth regions. We are now building our local presence and looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to help drive this next stage of growth.


This is a high-impact, execution-focused role where you will work closely with distributors and retail partners to grow the brand, develop local markets, and deliver commercial results. You will play a key role in shaping our LATAM business from an early stage.


You will join a diverse, fast-growing, and entrepreneurial team where ownership, speed, and results matter. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building markets rather than just managing them.


Key Responsibilities


Commercial Strategy & Market Development

  • Support the execution of LATAM sales plans across priority countries
  • Work with distributors to implement go-to-market activities and sales initiatives
  • Assist in building annual sales plans and forecasts with regional guidance
  • Support market expansion activities in selected countries and channels


Distributor & Retail Management

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with distributors and key retail partners
  • Support onboarding and activation of new distribution partners
  • Assist in pricing alignment, promotions, and product assortment execution
  • Monitor basic sell-in / sell-out performance and flag risks or opportunities
  • Support in-store execution including product visibility and promotions


Sales Execution & Performance Management

  • Track and report sales performance across assigned markets
  • Support KPI monitoring including sell-in, sell-out, and inventory levels
  • Assist in preparation of sales reports and market updates
  • Gather competitor and market insights from distributors and retailers


Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with supply chain and logistics teams on order and delivery tracking
  • Support marketing and sales teams in adapting materials for local markets
  • Provide regular feedback from distributors and customers



Preferred Backgrounds

  • Pool equipment, home appliances, consumer electronics, or similar industries
  • Experience working with distributors or retail partners in Latin America
  • Exposure to B2B or channel sales environments is a strong plus


Experience & Qualifications Required

  • 3–6 years of sales or channel management experience in Latin America
  • Experience working with distributors, retailers, or sales partners
  • Understanding of retail or channel-based sales models
  • Fluent Spanish required; Portuguese (Brazil) is a strong advantage
  • Good level of English for internal communication
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment
  • Willingness to travel within Latin America


Profile & Soft Skills

  • Hands-on and execution-oriented
  • Strong relationship builder with distributors and customers
  • Practical, structured, and reliable in follow-through
  • Comfortable working independently with guidance from HQ
  • Curious and eager to grow into a regional leadership role


What Success Looks Like (First 12–18 Months)

  • Clear distributor structure in priority LATAM markets.
  • Consistent sell-in growth supported by improving sell-out performance.
  • Strong retail presence with controlled inventory and margin discipline.
  • Reliable forecasting and structured market reporting.
  • LATAM positioned as a scalable and repeatable growth region.

title: Billing Analyst
description:

  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.

Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.

title: AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.
